name: FCW
recent: FCW 近期完成第71届常年股东大会，所有议案获股东通过；同时董事局及审计、提名、薪酬委员会出现人事变动，Mr Woo Hin Weng 与 Mr Teh Kay Yeong 先后加入相关委员会。公司也发布了截至2026年6月30日止季度的业绩报告。
notable: 第71届常年股东大会于2026年9月4日举行，所有普通决议案获股东以投票方式通过。
Mr Woo Hin Weng 于2026年11月1日加入审计、提名、薪酬委员会及董事局。
Mr Teh Kay Yeong 于2026年9月30日加入审计、薪酬委员会及董事局。

recent_en: FCW recently concluded its 71st Annual General Meeting with all resolutions approved by shareholders. There were board and committee changes, with Mr Woo Hin Weng and Mr Teh Kay Yeong appointed to the Audit, Nomination and Remuneration Committees. The company also released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026.
notable_en: The 71st AGM was held on 4 September 2026 and all ordinary resolutions were approved by shareholders via poll.
Mr Woo Hin Weng was appointed to the Audit, Nomination and Remuneration Committees and the Board on 1 November 2026.
Mr Teh Kay Yeong was appointed to the Audit and Remuneration Committees and the Board on 30 September 2026.
